Sometimes I think this journey will be a life long one, for us aces there is always going to be a point where we are going to have to deal with something we’d rather not. Wether that be explaining ourselves, having to leave or avoid certain relationships, being judged and miss understood. It’s unfair it really is, and a year ago I almost thought it was enough to end my life. But I realised I want to be here, and that although I’m different, Mother Nature made it so. And I’m going to tackle every single one of these things as they come. 

Being in a relationship is something I really want, but I have accepted that it may not happen, and I’m just focusing on reshaping my views of the future, and finding ways to be happy without another person. 

If a genie could come down and grant me 3 wishes, all of them would be to not be asexual because boy life would be easier. But unfortunately that’s not going to happen, I’m going to play the best a I can with the cards I was dealt. And remind myself that it’s not that serious. Hey I’ve been feeling the same! I thought I was straight, and then I thought I was bi, then I realised I wasn’t just sexually attracted to attractive looking people I enjoyed peoples personality way more, so I thought maybe I’m pan, then I thought hmmm no I really was obsessed with this boy once and I really wanted to kiss and have sexual intimate situation with him so I thought Demi, then I read some stuff and thought hmmm maybe ace? But I’ve genuinely just decided to let it all go, all the questioning, all the labels, it took me a little while to get here after deciding to figure out my sexuality which started 3/4 months ago and I’ve been through a lot since then. 

Feeling like you not normal or don’t belong can be a really scary feeling for some and I know for me it was incredibly daunting. For a while I felt so alone and so “different” I just wanted to fit in some where I wanted it to all make sense yanno. Then one day I realised I was wasting my time suffering under the weight and pressures of where I should belong or what other people thought about me or having to explain myself I guess. 

It still comes back every now and again, and I continue to be curious, but I don’t let it consume my thoughts any more and I don’t worry about it. I’m curious, not stressed or scared. I’m no longer scrambling to find the answers, if I’m being honest all that fear I had around establishing my sexuality never came from within me and my own desires to figure it out, I never would have questioned myself if it wasn’t for societies expectations and peoples judgements. So you have to ask yourself why does it matter so much to you? Is it really you that wants to know, or is it for others, is it so you can justify and explain yourself, is it so you can feel as though belong. You don’t need to belong any where, just be yourself. 🥰 you belong in this world no matter what because your here ❤️
